lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arrangement of high-luminance circular spots in distinct horizontal rows. Larger spots are aligned along the mid-lateral axis with regular spacing that increases posteriorly, while smaller, more densely clustered spots are observed in the anterior-dorsal transition area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal carinae and spot rows, forming a structural checkerboard pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges extending along the flank, each defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with specular highlights on the upper boundary and shadowing on the lower boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Two Echeneidae specimens (remoras) are visible positioned ventrally beneath the mid-section and pectoral fin.
